lines.say: Lending vaults lend out almost everything you deposit.
lines.caption: Lending vaults lend out almost everything you deposit.

lines.say: When borrowing is heavy, the vault runs dry, and your withdrawal simply fails.
lines.caption: When borrowing is heavy, the vault runs dry, and your withdrawal simply fails.

lines.say: In November twenty twenty-five, two Gauntlet vaults on Morpho stayed under one percent withdrawable, for about six hours.
lines.caption: In November 2025, two Gauntlet vaults on Morpho stayed under 1% withdrawable, for about six hours.

lines.say: What happens when a borrower finally repays? We measured it, on Base mainnet.
lines.caption: What happens when a borrower finally repays? We measured it, on Base mainnet.

lines.say: Over the last year, borrowers repaid into a dry Morpho market one hundred and thirty-five times.
lines.caption: Over the last year, borrowers repaid into a dry Morpho market 135 times.

lines.say: Nobody was in line for that cash. It was taken a median of one point six hours later, first come, first served.
lines.caption: Nobody was in line for that cash. It was taken a median of 1.6 hours later, first come, first served.

lines.say: Spillway puts lenders in line, and the line pays itself.
lines.caption: Spillway puts lenders in line, and the line pays itself.

lines.say: The moment a borrower repays, a Reactive contract pays everyone waiting, in order, in about one and a half seconds.
lines.caption: The moment a borrower repays, a Reactive contract pays everyone waiting, in order, in about 1.5 seconds.

lines.say: This is the live app, on Base Sepolia. No wallet needed.
lines.caption: This is the live app, on Base Sepolia. No wallet needed.

lines.say: I queue a two dollar withdrawal. The vault is fully lent out, so it waits in line.
lines.caption: I queue a 2 USDC withdrawal. The vault is fully lent out, so it waits in line.

lines.say: Now the borrower repays. That's all. Nobody touches the vault.
lines.caption: Now the borrower repays. That's all. Nobody touches the vault.

lines.say: Open the request. Paid, one point six seconds after the repayment landed.
lines.caption: Open the request. Paid, 1.6 seconds after the repayment landed.

lines.say: Three transactions: the repayment on Base, the reactive transaction on Reactive Lasna, and the payout, back on Base.
lines.caption: Three transactions: the repayment on Base, the reactive transaction on Reactive Lasna, and the payout, back on Base.

lines.say: On the Reactive explorer, you can see the callback it sent to Base, confirmed.
lines.caption: On the Reactive explorer, you can see the callback it sent to Base, confirmed.

lines.say: Rather not wait at all? Sell your place to the pool.
lines.caption: Rather not wait at all? Sell your place to the pool.

lines.say: Before you sign, you see what you give up, what comes back right away, the fee, and the most you can lose.
lines.caption: Before you sign, you see what you give up, what comes back right away, the fee, and the most you can lose.

lines.say: One click. The wallet signs an approval, then the sale.
lines.caption: One click. The wallet signs an approval, then the sale.

lines.say: And the cash is already in your wallet.
lines.caption: And the cash is already in your wallet.

lines.say: Here's how it works.
lines.caption: Here's how it works.

lines.say: On Reactive Lasna, our reactor listens for one thing: an approved borrower repaying its own loan, in our Morpho market.
lines.caption: On Reactive Lasna, our reactor listens for one thing: an approved borrower repaying its own loan, in our Morpho market.

lines.say: It calls back through Reactive's proxy to Base, where our contract pays the queue, first in, first out, and records the time in milliseconds.
lines.caption: It calls back through Reactive's proxy to Base, where our contract pays the queue, first in, first out, and records the time in milliseconds.

lines.say: And it's built to resist abuse.
lines.caption: And it's built to resist abuse.

lines.say: A stranger can't call the callback, can't mint collateral to borrow, and can't feed the reactor a fake event. Each call is refused, on chain.
lines.caption: A stranger can't call the callback, can't mint collateral to borrow, and can't feed the reactor a fake event. Each is refused on chain.

lines.say: Seventy-seven tests attack every finding in our threat model.
lines.caption: 77 tests attack every finding in our threat model.

lines.say: Every loop is timed on chain. On the current contracts, the median is one point four seconds.
lines.caption: Every loop is timed on chain. On the current contracts, the median is 1.4 seconds.

lines.say: Spillway runs on testnets today, with test funds and our own Morpho market. Next is a real market, with a curator.
lines.caption: Spillway runs on testnets today, with test funds and our own Morpho market. Next: a real market, with a curator.

lines.say: Try it at spillway dash phi dot vercel dot app. And try to break it.
lines.caption: Try it at spillway-phi.vercel.app. And try to break it.
